title: Bee Removal in Gravesend, Brooklyn
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Gravesend, Brooklyn. Nest treatment, removal, and entry-point sealing. Licensed. (855) 930-5016.
intro: Best Pest Control NYC provides expert bee removal services throughout Gravesend, Brooklyn — identifying and treating wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nests in homes and businesses. Our licensed technicians locate the nest, treat it through the entry point, remove accessible nest material, and seal every opening to prevent recolonization. Honeybee colonies are referred to a licensed beekeeper.
whyUs: With over a decade serving Gravesend residents, we understand the unique challenges posed by bee infestations in this densely populated Brooklyn neighborhood. Our team responds quickly, uses safe removal methods that protect your family and property, and offers competitive flat-rate pricing with no hidden fees.
localContext: Gravesend's mix of single-family homes, brick row houses, and older apartment buildings near Avenue U and Kings Highway often attract wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets seeking shelter in eaves, chimneys, and wall voids. The tree-lined streets and proximity to parks like Gravesend Park create ideal conditions for seasonal wasp and hornet nesting activity, making professional nest treatment and removal essential for homeowners and property managers in this South Brooklyn neighborhood.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Gravesend?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in Gravesend?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day wasp and hornet nest removal services throughout Gravesend, Brooklyn. Most nest treatments and removals are completed within 1–2 hours, though larger or hard-to-reach nests in wall voids may require additional time.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Gravesend?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Do you remove wasp and hornet nests from walls and attics in Gravesend homes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in treating and removing wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket nests from all locations including walls, attics, chimneys, soffits, and crawl spaces common in Gravesend's residential properties. We also seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
